subject.title: fix(azure): responses model aliases route correctly

question: Should maintainers accept the local mock Azure Responses probe plus focused resolver coverage as sufficient proof for this auth-provider routing fix, or require a live Azure credential exchange before merge?
rationale: The changed code chooses provider ownership before network credentials are exchanged, but the behavior affects auth-provider routing and the contributor explicitly did not test live Azure credentials.

options.title: Accept resolver-layer proof
options.body: Treat the mock Responses probe and focused tests as sufficient for this resolver-layer bug, then merge after exact-head CI is green.

options.title: Require live Azure proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted live Azure models status probe or agent smoke before merge.

options.title: Pause for alias-contract redesign
options.body: Hold the PR if maintainers want a broader permanent model-catalog alias contract instead of this focused fix.

recommendation.title: Accept resolver-layer proof
recommendation.body: Treat the mock Responses probe and focused tests as sufficient for this resolver-layer bug, then merge after exact-head CI is green.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent OpenAI/Codex model-catalog work makes steipete the strongest owner for deciding proof sufficiency on this provider/auth boundary.
